_meta.cefr_source: Oxford 3000 A1-B2 + project Pre-A1 teaching band; progression documented in workbook CEFR_GUIDE

difficulty_progression.rule: MAY easiest; APR easy and below JUNE baseline; OCT challenge; MAR highest challenge for each level/subject
difficulty_progression.may_april_strategy: reinforcement selected from existing curriculum vocabulary
difficulty_progression.march_strategy: highest-scoring challenge vocabulary from the curriculum pool
difficulty_progression.score_basis: game CEFR band + lexical complexity (word length and multi-word penalty)
